jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a product owner, you ensure that your agile team is efficiently running. Together with the innovation management and team leads you are responsible for the creation of the team backlog. Your key function is to constantly manage, adapt & prioritize this backlog using an agile development approach. 

You build transparency and trust within your agile team and communicate effectively with the innovation management, product management and other stakeholders to keep them informed and engaged on the goals and progress with your very good management & communication skills.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Cooperate and collaborate with the Transformer Product Management, Innovation Management and Product Owners of transformer ART’s to ensure a high grade of alignment between overall backlog and team’s backlog
* Transfer prioritized overall backlog into team backlog and align content, priorities and way of realization with the development team
* Cooperate and collaborate with all interfaces on a regular basis to ensure that all relevant conditions, requirements and changes are transparent and considered at all times 
* Manage all resources and partners relevant for the adherence to the development targets in an international and cross collaborative environment
* Align and synchronize team backlog with the cycles of other backlogs

What You Bring

* University degree in engineering or a related technical field or equivalent experience
* Deep expertise in technologies relevant to high-voltage transformer components and products development, ideally with experience in research, prototyping, or technology validation
* Strong ability to translate innovative technology concepts into tangible product ideas, balancing creativity with practical feasibility and market potential.
* Proven capability in managing and steering collaborations with internal R&D teams, external research partners, and industry stakeholders to accelerate innovation and knowledge transfer.
* Agile mindset - Experience in leading agile teams, embrace change, foster collaboration, and drive continuous improvement with the focus on customer value
* Very good communication skills and fluent in English
* Willingness to travel (20%) 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology team enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

During your workday, you collaborate in a HIL laboratory with the automation and electrical simulation team to adjust settings for a VSC-based converter system undergoing testing. Afterward, you meet with a client to discuss the capabilities of the VSC-based converter solution. Following lunch with colleagues, you work on the protection philosophy for an improved power supply design and conclude the day with a workshop with the R&D team focused on developing a new VSC-based power supply option.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* By supporting power supply development, project execution, and field service teams, this role offers a high level of responsibility, variety, visibility, and the opportunity to make a tangible impact.
* Supporting the development/ integration of innovative, competitive and reliable solutions for VSC based power converters in MW-area under consideration of the interfaces to the other power supply components (transformer, busbar system) and the requirements of the electrolyzer systems
* Provide expert support for our commissioning and service teams with regards to VSC-based power supply systems for electrolysis
* Support Hardware-in-the-Loop testing activities with regards to VSC-based power supply systems
* Provide expert support regarding the application of VSC-based converter systems in large electrolysis systems and plants 
* Adopt technology scouting for trends in converter technology to generate innovative ideas for future electrolysis plants

What You Bring

* Master’s degree or PhD in electrical engineering, with focus on power engineering or power electronics
* Long-standing experience in the field of VSC-based megawatt-scale converters (e.g., for PV, wind, BESS, and drives), including roles in commissioning, testing, product management, project execution, field service, product application, or similar
* Sound knowledge and experience in the areas electrical power distribution, power electronics, and converter control
* Wide knowledge of relevant global standards, regulations, and guidelines in the VSC converter domain 
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken. German is a plus.
* Willingness and pleasure to develop joint innovative solutions in interdisciplinary teams as well as willingness to travel

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Researcher (f/m/d) in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 November 2026:

Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)

in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals** (m/f/d)**

(Full time / part time** **options available)

﻿

Location: Frankfurt am Main
Employment scope: Full-time; part time options are available
Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 years
Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.

There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.

Your tasks

- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses
- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches
- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling
- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses
- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party funding

Your profile

- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field
- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.
- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage
- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R
- Very good written and oral communication skills in English
- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigenetics

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, gender, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application as a single PDF by 5 October 2026, including:

- CV
- Letter of motivation
- Academic transcripts and certificates/credentials
- Two relevant publications
- Contact details of two potential references

Please compress the files where possible. If the two publications cause the file to exceed the upload limit, they may be uploaded separately.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Axel Janke ataxel.janke@senckenberg.de

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/

Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

Your Tasks

If you have proven experience with offshore foundation T&I contracts, BIMCO agreements, and marine logistics services, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and contribute your expertise to the successful delivery of complex offshore projects from tendering through execution.

- Management of offshore T&I-related contracts, including Guard Vessels, CTVs, SOVs, and associated marine services (BIMCO-based agreements).
- Contractual support for general offshore logistics, including small purchasing items and ad-hoc service agreements.
- Coordination and contractual oversight for weather data services, wave buoys, and metocean-related contracts.
- Interface with suppliers, vessel owners, and internal project teams to align contractual terms with operational requirements.
- Support tendering, ITT responses, and contract clarifications in close coordination with project, marine, and procurement teams.

Your qualifications

- Strong working knowledge of BIMCO contracts and marine service agreements.
- Experience managing operational, low-value purchasing contracts alongside larger marine agreements.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher Health Economics / Health Data Science  (Psychologe/Psychologin)
jobs.description:
...you're in the middle of it

The position is embedded in EU-MIC (European Coalition for Mental Health Medicines Innovation), a strategic initiative led by the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology (ECNP). EU-MIC aims to address the growing innovation gap in psychopharmacology between Europe and the United States and to examine the structural disparities between mental and somatic health in access to innovative medicines.

A major workstream of the project focuses on the quantification of the direct and indirect societal costs of mental disorders, including:

- healthcare and treatment costs
- sick leave, retirement and disability-related costs
- productivity losses
- presenteeism and absenteeism
- broader social and long-term economic consequences

The resulting evidence will contribute to scientific publications, European policy reports, and advocacy activities targeting regulators, HTA bodies, payers, policymakers, clinicians, patients, and carers.

The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extending it to three years. There is also the opportunity to pursue a habilitation.

Your Role:

- Develop and implement a health-economic data analysis plan within EU-MIC
- Identify, collate, harmonise, and analyse national and international datasets (which, in part, will also be delivered by the supporting companies) and evidence sources
- Model direct and indirect costs of mental disorders across European healthcare systems
- Quantify presenteeism, productivity losses, and wider societal economic impacts
- Conduct systematic evidence reviews, evidence synthesis, and health-economic modelling
- Establish transparent data structures, metadata standards, and reproducible analytical workflows
- Prepare peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, policy briefs, and stakeholder presentations
- Collaborate closely with international experts in psychiatry, health economics, HTA, public affairs, and patient organisations
- Contribute to the strategic development of EU-MIC and future European research and funding initiatives

... your skills are what we're looking for

- PhD (or equivalent doctoral degree) in Health Economics, Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Data Science, Medicine, Psychology, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated expertise in the analysis of large healthcare, claims, registry, or real-world datasets
- Strong statistical and programming skills (R, Python, Stata, or SAS)
- Experience in health-economic evaluation, cost-of-illness studies, HTA, or real-world evidence generation is highly desirable
- Interest in mental health, health services research, and European health policy
- Excellent written and spoken English; German language skills are advantageous but not required
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international interdisciplinary environment
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

... you'll be offered a lot

- In addition to an attractive salary based on acollective agreement (TV-G-U)with an annual special payment, you benefit from long-term security through company pension schemes

- Free public transport in all Hessen (Free State Ticket Hessen)
- Participation in a high-profile European flagship initiative addressing the future of mental health innovation
- Integration into the international ECNP community
- Excellent research infrastructure at one of Germany’s largest academic psychiatry departments
- Opportunity to pursue a habilitation and develop an independent academic profile
